items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Ralph Collins is here too interviewing Albert Giles...

ctx.x: Okay Albert, do you want to give your name to start? Albert Giles is my name. This is Bill Russell and Ralph Collins is here too interviewing Albert Giles at 1816 Onzaga Street and the date is June the 15th 1960. Can you tell us just where you were born and the date? Well I was born in Tibidot, Louisiana. Remember your wife has to tell you your birthday. That's all right.
November the 12th. November the 27th. November 27th? That's right. And what year? 1905. Same year I was born. Same year you were born. Well that's wonderful. It was in Tibidot. Can you tell us
